summary: AirJoule Technologies Corp. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) for a registered direct offering of 3,658,536 shares of Class A common stock at $4.10 per share, a 14.4% discount to the $4.79 last sale on May 28, 2026. Titan Partners Group LLC acts as sole placement agent on a best-efforts basis with no minimum required. The offering is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; it lacks a tender, acquisition, restructuring, or activist element. Watch for dilution and stock price reaction post-offer.
